description: This file is a shell script that performs testing of 'git status' with the fsmonitor extension and related functionalities within the Git version control system. It contains setup routines, test cases, and validation steps to ensure correct behavior of fsmonitor integration, including interactions with untracked cache, sparse indices, and repository state management.

methods.name: clean_repo
methods.description: Resets the repository to a clean state by performing a hard reset and cleaning untracked files.

methods.name: dirty_repo
methods.description: Introduces untracked and modified files into the repository to simulate a dirty working directory.

methods.name: write_integration_script
methods.description: Sets up the fsmonitor test hook with a specific output for integration validation.

methods.name: check_sparse_index_behavior
methods.description: Verifies whether the status command triggers ensure_full_index based on sparse index configuration.
